name: Runner Tests Fixture - Tdd Page Triggers
brief: Proves --tdd (#5309) annotates a test that reaches a generated stub through a page's own code a TestPage runs.
description: Proves --tdd (#5309) annotates a test that reaches a generated stub through the triggers and events of a page, a control's field triggers and an action's OnAction, each started by the TestPage call that runs it, and leaves a test that runs none of them unannotated.
